goal: B5c: the ghost hull in 3D on /log, a plank opening its record
outcome: merged: Lens ship on 9b8743a after one fix round (one important finding acted on: hover dead after a press dragged off the canvas) with two nits riding; Iris ship at 8.7/10; 184 of 184 checks; no owner path touched

wentWrong.what: The first number placement on the turned hull put numbers on its seams, then drifted them to their planks' ends
wentWrong.evidence: Iris's early look counted lines through seven numbers at 1024, and her review measured "6" 169 px aft; numbers now sit in their planks' middle half, with "8" led out (decisions.md, 6)

wentWrong.what: A press dragged off the 3D hull left hovering dead until the next press
wentWrong.evidence: Lens traced it on d430702; a drag-off is now a cancelled click, with a check that fails without the fix (decisions.md, 10)

wentWrong.what: The record page could shift 73 px on a slow first paint, because the drawing comes later in the page than on screen
wentWrong.evidence: Forge reproduced the failing CLS of 0.0699 exactly by splitting the HTML before the record; the Log now holds its first paint until the drawing is parsed (decisions.md, 11)

proposals.change: Let roles force-push their own role branches, or name them per run from the start (<role>/<n>-r<k>)
proposals.moves: Branches a role leaves behind: pixel/33 and probe/33 stalled when force-pushes were refused, and the work moved to -r2 mid-sprint

proposals.change: Give CI's check job a timeout that scales with the suite, or split the 3D specs into their own job
proposals.moves: Cancelled runs: B5c's specs first took CI's e2e step past its 25-minute cap (decision 12)

proposals.change: Sprint 32's still stand: a workflow that writes the merge record after each merge, and moving merge-record.mjs into .crew/ with a test
proposals.moves: How long the newest revision sits under Undated

followUps.what: B5's demo on a preview that deploys: the ghost on a GPU and a phone, the move's feel, the pick, and Iris's departures (two translucent sides, no lede words, no numbers below 768, "8" led out)
Lens's two nits on 9b8743a: a restored context redraws the last hovered plank's mark, and a tap's mark clears before its navigation (lib/model/mount.ts)
The render-blocking expect link holds the Log's shift in Chromium only; matching the DOM order to the visual order below 1024 would fix it everywhere (Iris's call)
